title: A Sign in the Sky
text: A star falls over the town at night. The faithful see in it a sign from the Master.

title: A Suspicious Neighbour
text: A neighbour asks why singing comes from the cellar at night.

title: Offerings of the Faithful
text: A wealthy believer brings a purse. They say it is for a favour received.

title: Candles Snuffed
text: In the middle of the prayer every candle goes out at once. Nobody knows why.

title: A Sermon against Heresy
text: A priest of Sigmar thunders from the pulpit about heretics in town. Some of the faithful stay away from the meeting.

title: A New Initiate
text: A young journeyman swears the oath and receives a name in the brotherhood. All welcome them warmly.

title: A Book from the Market
text: At the junk market someone is selling a book with strange signs. You buy it before a priest sees it.

title: The High Priest's Dream
text: The high priest wakes screaming and says the Master is displeased.

title: Provisions from Offerings
text: The faithful bring bread and wine for the feast after the rite.

title: An Apostate
text: One of the faithful has not come for a week. They say they pray in the temple now.

title: A Hunter at the Inn
text: A man in a black hat has taken a room at the inn. He asks about the missing.

title: Incense and Oil
text: The rites need incense and oil. The stores are running low.

title: Stones in the Mist
text: Mist hangs over the stone circle though the night around is clear. The faithful take it as the Master's favour.

title: A Shepherd by the Fire
text: A shepherd sees your fires on the hill and runs to the village shouting.

title: A Cave of Drawings
text: A cave holds old drawings that look like the brotherhood's signs. The high priest has them copied.

title: Hunger in Camp
text: There is nothing to feed the faithful in the woods. The fast is called penance, but stomachs growl all the same.

title: Wolves at the Circle
text: Wolves circle the stones until dawn. Nobody dares break off the prayer.

title: Herbs from the Clearing
text: Rare herbs for incense grow in a clearing. The faithful fill their baskets.

title: A Pilgrim from Afar
text: A pilgrim from another city who knows the brotherhood's signs arrives with offerings from the brothers there.

title: An Eclipse
text: At midday the sun darkens for a moment. Preachers in the market cry of the end of the world, and the faithful smile.

title: A Search at the Baker's
text: The watch searches the house of a baker who belongs to the brotherhood. They find nothing, but the baker is terrified.

title: A Forbidden Book
text: Someone in the brotherhood has copied a chapter of a forbidden book. The high priest reads it by candlelight until dawn.

title: A Blackmailer
text: Someone knows who visits the cellar and demands money for silence.

title: A Dispute over the Rite
text: Two senior brothers argue over the words of the invocation. The dispute splits the cult in two.

title: A Generous Noble
text: An impoverished noble seeks the Master's help to restore their fortune. To begin with, they pay in gold.

title: A Priest at the Door
text: A priest of Sigmar goes from house to house with holy water, and lingers longer at your door than anywhere else.

title: A Feast after the Rite
text: After the rite there is wine and roast meat. The faithful leave at dawn, united as never before.

title: Bad Dreams
text: Several of the faithful dream the same dream of black water. The high priest says nothing, which unsettles them more.

title: A Friend in the Town Hall
text: A scribe from the town hall warns that someone has asked for the sanctum's address.

title: A Lost Amulet
text: A believer has lost an amulet bearing the brotherhood's sign. Everyone searches the streets until morning.

title: A Merchant's Gift
text: A merchant of the brotherhood sends a cart of stores as a gift to the Master.

title: The Empty Chalice
text: By morning the chalice on the altar is empty, though nobody drank the wine. The faithful are sure the Master is listening.

title: A Mocker under the Window
text: A drunk under the window jeers at the 'night prayers' and threatens to go to the temple.
okText: The zealot goes out to him and the drunk never comes back to the area.

title: Doubt in the Ranks
text: Some of the faithful ask whether the Master exists at all.
okText: The orator speaks until dawn and the doubters leave with burning eyes.

title: A Poisonous Vapour
text: The draught in the cauldron starts smoking green. The cellar fills with fumes.
okText: The alchemist adds a powder that quenches the reaction. Only a smell of sulphur remains.

title: Word from the Temple
text: It is said the temple is preparing something against the brotherhood.
okText: The spy returns with a list of names the priests want to question.

title: A Witness
text: Someone saw a believer leaving the cellar in robes.
okText: The assassin settles the matter before dawn. The witness leaves to stay with relatives in the country.

title: Missing Candles
text: There are no candles for the rite and the shop is shut.
okText: The acolyte returns with a basket of candles from the cemetery chapel. Nobody asks where from.

title: Ambush in the Woods
text: Robbers stop the faithful on the way to the circle.
okText: The zealot hurls themself at them bare-handed and the robbers flee from the madman.

title: A Crowd at the Temple
text: In the square a crowd listens to a preacher who blames sorcerers for the plague.
okText: The orator works the crowd and turns its anger on the tax collector. Nobody talks about the brotherhood any more.

title: Missing Ingredients
text: A rare root is missing for the ritual draughts.
okText: The alchemist substitutes something from their own drawer. It works even better.

title: A List of Names
text: A witch hunter is drawing up a list of suspects.
okText: The spy obtains a copy and adds the names of the brotherhood's enemies.

title: A Tracker in the Woods
text: A witch hunters' tracker follows the faithful through the forest.
okText: The assassin waits by the stream. The tracker does not return.

title: The Fire Goes Out
text: The wind puts out the fire on the stone altar in the middle of the rite.
okText: The acolyte shields the flame with their cloak and lights it again.
